ai_baseline: Existing Linear Regression LOSO out-of-fold predictions
hybrid_method: AI predicts the residual between actual X50 and Kuznetsov mathematical X50.
hybrid_validation: Residual models are retrained inside each LOSO fold. The held-out site's measurements are not used for training.
ensemble_method: Fixed 50:50 average of mathematical and existing AI predictions.
limitations: Only 85 records from eight sites are available.
The mathematical rock factors were back-solved from published predictions.
The existing AI predictions are out-of-fold predictions from Experiment 2.
Results measure generalisation to held-out sites in this dataset, not all mines.
The fixed 50:50 ensemble weight was not optimized.
